/* PdaLocationPaloMapper.selectEmptyLocation : 로케이션적치 - 공로케이션조회 */
SELECT CODE AS LOCATION_PLACE_CODE, NAME_DEFAULT AS LOCATION_PLACE_NAME, LOCATION_PLACE FROM ( SELECT CODE, NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL LOC WHERE LOC.GROUP_CODE = 'WH_LOCATION' ) W LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LOCATION_PLACE FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE LOCATION_STATUS = 'L' AND DELETE_YN = 'N' GROUP BY LOCATION_PLACE ) PW ON W.CODE = PW.LOCATION_PLACE WHERE PW.LOCATION_PLACE IS NULL
mapper.update: /* PdaLocationPaloMapper.batchUpdateInPlanPkgLocationInfo : 로케이션정보 일괄 업데이트 */ UPDATE _pkg SET _pkg.LOCATION_STATUS = #{locationStatus} , _pkg.UPDATE_USER_ID = #{updateUserId} , _pkg.UPDATE_DATE_TIME = GETDATE() , _pkg.LOCATION_PLACE = '' FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG _pkg JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN _inPlan WITH (NOLOCK) ON _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO = _inPlan.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE _pkg.PACKING_NO IN (#{item.packingNo}) AND _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO IN (#{item.inPlanNo}) AND _inPlan.BL_NO IN (#{item.blNo})
mapper.select: /* PdaLocationPaloMapper.selectLocationPlace : 로케이션적치 - 로케이션정보 조회 for front */ SELECT TOP 1 CODE AS LOCATION_PLACE , NAME_DEFAULT AS LOCATION_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL LOC WHERE LOC.GROUP_CODE = 'WH_LOCATION' AND LOC.CODE = #{srchWhLocation}

/* PdaLocationPaloMapper.selectLocationInfoDetail : 로케이션적치 - 로케이션정보 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 CODE AS CODE , NAME_DEFAULT AS NAME FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL LOC WHERE LOC.GROUP_CODE = 'WH_LOCATION' AND LOC.CODE = #{locationPlace}

/* PdaLocationPaloMapper.selectPkgWithBmsInByLocation : 로케이션에 의한 박스리스트조회 */ SELECT '반입' , _in.BL_NO , _pkg.PACKING_NO , _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO , _pkg.LOCATION_PLACE , _pkg.LOCATION_STATUS , _in.CT , _pkg.WEIGHING_WT , _in.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , _in.IN_NO , _in.OD_JOB_NO , H.CARRYOUT_STOP_YN , ISNULL(H.HOLD_HISTORY, 'N') AS HOLD_HISTORY , CASE WHEN _in.SE_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE_A <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE_B <> '' OR _in.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' OR _in.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INSPECTION_TYPE , (SELECT SUBSTRING(_out_plan.APPROVAL_DATE, 6, 5) FROM TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN _out_plan WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE _out_plan.IN_NO = _in.IN_NO) AS APPROVAL_DATE_MMDD , CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, _in.CARRYIN_DATE, GETDATE()) + 1 < 1 THEN 1 ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, _in.CARRYIN_DATE, GETDATE()) + 1 END AS STORAGE_DAYS , ISNULL(IR.M_INSPECTION_FINISH_YN, 'N') AS INSPECTION_FINISH_YN FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG _pkg WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN _in WITH (NOLOCK) ON _in.IN_PLAN_NO = _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Y' AS HOLD_HISTORY , OD_JOB_NO , MAX(CARRYOUT_STOP_YN) AS CARRYOUT_STOP_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO) H ON _in.OD_JOB_NO = H.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT IN_NO, MIN(INSPECTION_FINISH_YN) M_INSPECTION_FINISH_YN FROM TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY IN_NO) IR ON _in.IN_NO = IR.IN_NO WHERE _pkg.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND _pkg.LOCATION_PLACE = #{locationPlace} AND _pkg.LOCATION_STATUS = 'L' ORDER BY _in.BL_NO

/* PdaLocationPaloMapper.selectPkgWithBmsInByPackingNoList : 박스번호리스트에 의한 박스리스트조회 */ SELECT '반입' , _in.BL_NO , _pkg.PACKING_NO , _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO , _pkg.LOCATION_PLACE , _pkg.LOCATION_STATUS , _pkg.IN_CT , _pkg.WEIGHING_WT , _in.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , _in.IN_NO , _in.OD_JOB_NO , H.CARRYOUT_STOP_YN , ISNULL(H.HOLD_HISTORY, 'N') AS HOLD_HISTORY , CASE WHEN _in.SE_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE_A <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE_B <> '' OR _in.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' OR _in.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INSPECTION_TYPE , SUBSTRING(_out_plan.APPROVAL_DATE, 6, 5) AS APPROVAL_DATE_MMDD , _out_plan.APPROVAL_DATE , CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, _in.CARRYIN_DATE, GETDATE()) + 1 < 1 THEN 1 ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, _in.CARRYIN_DATE, GETDATE()) + 1 END AS STORAGE_DAYS FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG _pkg WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN _in WITH (NOLOCK) ON _in.IN_PLAN_NO = _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Y' AS HOLD_HISTORY , OD_JOB_NO , MAX(CARRYOUT_STOP_YN) AS CARRYOUT_STOP_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO ) H ON _in.OD_JOB_NO = H.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN _out_plan WITH (NOLOCK) ON _out_plan.IN_NO = _in.IN_NO WHERE _pkg.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND _pkg.LOCATION_PLACE = #{locationPlace} AND _pkg.PACKING_NO IN (#{item.packingNo}) AND _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO IN (#{item.inPlanNo}) AND _in.BL_NO IN (#{item.blNo})

/* PdaLocationPaloMapper.getPkgPaloListByCurrentLocation : 현재 로케이션에 해당하는 박스 리스트 조회 */ SELECT _pkg.SEQ , _pkg.BL_NO , _pkg.PACKING_NO , _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO , _pkg.OUT_CT , _pkg.LOCATION_PLACE , _pkg.ORIG_LOCATION_PLACE , _pkg.LOCATION_STATUS , COALESCE(_in.CT, inPlan.EX_CT, 0) AS CT , COALESCE(_in.WT, inPlan.EX_WT, 0) AS WT , COALESCE(_in.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, inPlan.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, '') AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , _in.IN_NO , _in.OD_JOB_NO , H.CARRYOUT_STOP_YN , ISNULL(H.HOLD_HISTORY, 'N') AS HOLD_HISTORY , CASE WHEN ( _in.SE_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE_A <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE_B <> '' OR _in.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' OR _in.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' OR _in.BIG_SIZE_YN = 'Y' OR _in.INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN = 'Y' OR _in.INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN = 'Y' ) AND ISNULL(IR.M_INSPECTION_FINISH_YN, 'Y') = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INSPECTION , ISNULL(OP.APPROVAL_DATE, '') AS APPROVAL_DATE , CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, latest_in.CARRYIN_DATE, GETDATE()) + 1 < 1 THEN 1 ELSE ISNULL(DATEDIFF(DAY, latest_in.CARRYIN_DATE, GETDATE()) + 1, 0) END AS STORAGE_DAYS
, (SELECT TOP 1 SCAN_RESULT FROM TB_BMS_LOCATION_SCAN scan WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE scan.SCAN_NO = _pkg.PACKING_NO ORDER BY SEQ DESC) AS SCAN_RESULT
, '' AS SCAN_RESULT
FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG _pkg WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN inPlan WITH (NOLOCK) ON _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO = inPlan.IN_PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN _in WITH (NOLOCK) ON _in.IN_PLAN_NO = _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Y' AS HOLD_HISTORY , OD_JOB_NO , MAX(CARRYOUT_STOP_YN) AS CARRYOUT_STOP_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO) H ON _in.OD_JOB_NO = H.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN OP WITH (NOLOCK) ON _in.IN_NO = OP.IN_NO OUTER APPLY (SELECT MIN(INSPECTION_FINISH_YN) M_INSPECTION_FINISH_YN FROM TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT ins WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ins.IN_NO = _in.IN_NO GROUP BY IN_NO) IR OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 CARRYIN_DATE FROM TB_BMS_IN i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = inPlan.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO ORDER BY CAST(CARRYIN_DATE + ' ' + CARRYIN_TIME AS DATETIME) DESC ) latest_in WHERE _pkg.LOCATION_PLACE = #{locationPlace} OR _pkg.ORIG_LOCATION_PLACE = #{locationPlace} AND _pkg.DELETE_YN = 'N'

/* PdaLocationPaloMapper.getPkgPaloListByOrigLocation : 현재 로케이션에 해당하는 박스 리스트 조회 */ SELECT _pkg.SEQ , _pkg.BL_NO , _pkg.PACKING_NO , _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO , _pkg.OUT_CT , _pkg.LOCATION_PLACE , _pkg.ORIG_LOCATION_PLACE , _pkg.LOCATION_STATUS , COALESCE(_in.CT, inPlan.EX_CT, 0) AS CT , COALESCE(_in.WT, inPlan.EX_WT, 0) AS WT , COALESCE(_in.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, inPlan.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, '') AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , _in.IN_NO , _in.OD_JOB_NO , H.CARRYOUT_STOP_YN , ISNULL(H.HOLD_HISTORY, 'N') AS HOLD_HISTORY , CASE WHEN ( _in.SE_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE_A <> '' OR _in.INSPECTION_TYPE_B <> '' OR _in.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' OR _in.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE <> '' OR _in.BIG_SIZE_YN = 'Y' OR _in.INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN = 'Y' OR _in.INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN = 'Y' ) AND ISNULL(IR.M_INSPECTION_FINISH_YN, 'Y') = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS INSPECTION , ISNULL(OP.APPROVAL_DATE, '') AS APPROVAL_DATE , CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, latest_in.CARRYIN_DATE, GETDATE()) + 1 < 1 THEN 1 ELSE ISNULL(DATEDIFF(DAY, latest_in.CARRYIN_DATE, GETDATE()) + 1, 0) END AS STORAGE_DAYS
, (SELECT TOP 1 SCAN_RESULT FROM TB_BMS_LOCATION_SCAN scan WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE scan.SCAN_NO = _pkg.PACKING_NO ORDER BY SEQ DESC) AS SCAN_RESULT
, '' AS SCAN_RESULT
FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG _pkg WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN inPlan WITH (NOLOCK) ON _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO = inPlan.IN_PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN _in WITH (NOLOCK) ON _in.IN_PLAN_NO = _pkg.IN_PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Y' AS HOLD_HISTORY , OD_JOB_NO , MAX(CARRYOUT_STOP_YN) AS CARRYOUT_STOP_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO) H ON _in.OD_JOB_NO = H.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN OP WITH (NOLOCK) ON _in.IN_NO = OP.IN_NO OUTER APPLY (SELECT MIN(INSPECTION_FINISH_YN) M_INSPECTION_FINISH_YN FROM TB_BMS_INSPECT_RESULT ins WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ins.IN_NO = _in.IN_NO GROUP BY IN_NO) IR OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 CARRYIN_DATE FROM TB_BMS_IN i WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE i.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = inPlan.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO ORDER BY CAST(CARRYIN_DATE + ' ' + CARRYIN_TIME AS DATETIME) DESC ) latest_in WHERE _pkg.ORIG_LOCATION_PLACE = #{locationPlace} AND _pkg.DELETE_YN = 'N'
